import numpy as np
def T(tau,nu=6,N=14):
    s=np.sqrt(tau.imag)
    r=np.arange(-N,N+1);a,b=np.meshgrid(r,r)
    P=((a+b*tau)/s).ravel();P=P[np.abs(P)>1e-9]
    m=np.abs(P)<6
    P=P[m]
    X=P[:,None];Y=P[None,:]
    D=np.abs(X-Y);np.fill_diagonal(D,np.inf)
    return np.sum((np.abs(X)*np.abs(Y)*D)**(-nu))
for t in [np.exp(1j*np.pi/3),1j,0.25+1.2j,0.5+1j,0.5+0.9j,0.5+1.5j,1.5j,0.3+1j]:
    print(t,T(t))
E
